instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Huda Lafta Majeed
subject: 01_Cyber_Security

questions.question: Which two bodies develop the series ISO/IEC 27002 belongs to?
questions.question_ar: أي هيئتين تطوّران السلسلة التي ينتمي إليها ISO/IEC 27002؟
options: ISO and IEC, working together.
ISO alone, with national bodies.
IEC alone, with vendor groups.
ANSI and NIST, working together.
options_ar: منظمتا ISO و IEC معاً بشكل مشترك.
منظمة ISO وحدها مع هيئات وطنية.
منظمة IEC وحدها مع مجموعات موردين.
منظمتا ANSI و NIST معاً بشكل مشترك.
options_en: ISO and IEC, working together.
ISO alone, with national bodies.
IEC alone, with vendor groups.
ANSI and NIST, working together.
questions.explanation: The series is developed jointly by ISO and IEC, which is why both names appear in the title.
questions.explanation_ar: السلسلة تُطوَّر بالاشتراك بين ISO و IEC، ولهذا يظهر الاسمان في العنوان.

questions.question: Within how many categories does ISO/IEC 27002 define what has to be done?
questions.question_ar: داخل كم قسماً يحدد ISO/IEC 27002 ما يجب عمله؟
options: Eighteen categories.
Fourteen categories.
Twelve categories.
Sixteen categories.
options_en: Eighteen categories.
Fourteen categories.
Twelve categories.
Sixteen categories.
questions.explanation: The latest version describes what has to be done within fourteen categories.
questions.explanation_ar: أحدث إصدار يصف ما يجب عمله داخل أربعة عشر قسماً.

questions.question: Which edition year is paired with those fourteen categories?
questions.question_ar: أي سنة إصدار تقترن بالأقسام الأربعة عشر؟
questions.explanation: The edition that describes those categories is dated 2022.
questions.explanation_ar: الإصدار الذي يصف تلك الأقسام يعود لسنة 2022.

questions.question: Which category covers the use of cryptography?
options: The access control category of the standard.
The asset management category of the standard.
The operations security category of it.
The cryptography category of the standard.
options_en: The access control category of the standard.
The asset management category of the standard.
The operations security category of it.
The cryptography category of the standard.
questions.explanation: One of the fourteen categories is named Cryptography, which is how the standard groups keys, ciphers and their use.
questions.explanation_ar: أحد الأقسام الأربعة عشر اسمه التشفير، وفيه تجمع المواصفة المفاتيح والخوارزميات واستخدامها.

questions.question: Which category covers an external provider that must meet security requirements?
questions.question_ar: أي قسم يغطي مزوّداً خارجياً يجب أن يلبي متطلبات أمنية؟
options: The supplier relationships category.
The access control category of it.
The asset management category of it.
The operations security category.
options_en: The supplier relationships category.
The access control category of it.
The asset management category of it.
The operations security category.
questions.explanation: External providers sit under supplier relationships, one of the fourteen categories.
questions.explanation_ar: المزوّدون الخارجيون يقعون تحت علاقات الموردين، وهو أحد الأقسام الأربعة عشر.

questions.question: Which category covers keeping essential operations running through a disruption?
questions.question_ar: أي قسم يغطي إبقاء العمليات الأساسية عاملة خلال انقطاع؟
options: The access control category.
The business continuity category.
The incident management category.
The asset management category.
options_en: The access control category.
The business continuity category.
The incident management category.
The asset management category.
questions.explanation: Continuity of operations is its own category: information security aspects of business continuity management.
questions.explanation_ar: استمرارية العمليات قسم مستقل: جوانب أمن المعلومات لإدارة استمرارية الأعمال.

questions.question: Which category covers screening new employees before they get access?
questions.question_ar: أي قسم يغطي فحص الموظفين الجدد قبل منحهم الوصول؟
options: The asset management category of it.
The operations security category itself.
The human resource security category.
The access control category of it.
options_en: The asset management category of it.
The operations security category itself.
The human resource security category.
The access control category of it.
questions.explanation: Screening staff is human resource security. Access control is the separate category that governs permissions.
questions.explanation_ar: فحص الموظفين هو أمن الموارد البشرية. أما التحكم بالوصول فهو القسم المنفصل الذي ينظّم الصلاحيات.

questions.question: What does ISO/IEC 27002 give, compared with the other frameworks?
questions.question_ar: ماذا يعطي ISO/IEC 27002 مقارنة ببقية الأطر؟
options: A model for calculating the risk.
A process with three clear phases.
Objectives for measures that manage risk.
A checklist of what must be considered.
options_ar: عملية من ثلاث مراحل واضحة تماماً.
قائمة بما يجب أن يُؤخذ بالحسبان.
options_en: A model for calculating the risk.
A process with three clear phases.
Objectives for measures that manage risk.
A checklist of what must be considered.
questions.explanation: ISO/IEC 27002 is the checklist: it says what has to be considered for a secure system. FAIR calculates, OCTAVE runs a process, COBIT sets objectives.
questions.explanation_ar: ISO/IEC 27002 هو القائمة: يقول ما يجب أخذه بالحسبان لنظام آمن. وFAIR يحسب، وOCTAVE يدير عملية، وCOBIT يضع أهدافاً.

questions.question: Fourteen categories are attributed to the 2022 edition. What is the accurate position?
questions.question_ar: تُنسب أربعة عشر قسماً لإصدار 2022. ما الموقف الدقيق؟
options: It matches 2013; 2022 uses four themes.
It is correct and current for the 2022 edition.
It is a printing error in the printed table.
It counts controls, not the categories.
options_ar: خطأ مطبعي في الجدول المطبوع نفسه.
options_en: It matches 2013; 2022 uses four themes.
It is correct and current for the 2022 edition.
It is a printing error in the printed table.
It counts controls, not the categories.
questions.explanation: Fourteen is the 2013 structure. The 2022 edition reorganised into four themes with 93 controls. Use the familiar wording, but know the fact.
questions.explanation_ar: الأربعة عشر هي بنية 2013. وإصدار 2022 أعاد التنظيم إلى أربعة محاور و93 ضابطاً. استخدم الصياغة المتداولة، لكن اعرف الحقيقة.

questions.question: The fourteen categories are described as logically ordered. What does that order let you do?
questions.question_ar: الأقسام الأربعة عشر موصوفة بأنها مرتبة منطقياً. ماذا يتيح لك هذا الترتيب؟
options: It groups the categories by their cost.
It lets you follow a secure system's flow.
It makes the standard easier to translate.
It matches the order of the PDCA cycle.
options_ar: لأنها تجمع الأقسام حسب كلفتها كلها.
لأنها تتيح تتبّع مسار النظام الآمن.
لأنها تطابق ترتيب دورة PDCA تماماً.
options_en: It groups the categories by their cost.
It lets you follow a secure system's flow.
It makes the standard easier to translate.
It matches the order of the PDCA cycle.
questions.explanation: The categories run from policy, through organisation, people and assets, down to compliance, so the order follows how a secure system is built and run.
questions.explanation_ar: الأقسام تمشي من السياسة، عبر التنظيم والأفراد والأصول، وصولاً إلى الامتثال، فالترتيب يتبع كيفية بناء النظام الآمن وتشغيله.
